verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no data retention or deletion controls for Pipecat or Pipecat Cloud, such as retention periods, deletion APIs, or data-purge settings. Audio recording and transcript-capture docs describe collecting data, not controlling its retention. Self-hosting and local inference are deployment choices that only approximate data control, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
